verdict.rationale: The only bulk-style capability in the evidence is migration: importing many existing subscriptions from third-party systems via the no-code Billing migration toolkit, plus a multi-step data migration process. Nothing documents general bulk updates, cancellations or edits across many subscriptions, invoices or customers. missing for 10: a batch/bulk API or Dashboard bulk actions for updating or cancelling many items, bulk operations exposed via CLI/MCP for agent workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
